name: Digital Payment Settlement
definition: Specifies the information related to the digital payment settlement.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

NetworkFeeQuantity.name: Network Fee Quantity
NetworkFeeQuantity.definition: Quantity of digital assets for network fee assigned to a transaction on a DLT network.

ElectronicMoneyTokenSettlementQuantity.name: Electronic Money Token Settlement Quantity
ElectronicMoneyTokenSettlementQuantity.definition: Quantity of E-money token for the settlement payment.

DigitalLedgerIdentification.name: Digital Ledger Identification
DigitalLedgerIdentification.definition: Place of safekeeping expressed with a Digital Ledger Identifier. It identifies a digital ledger or distributed ledger system (for example, blockchain or similar platforms).

ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN). A numbering system designed by the United Nation's International Organisation for Standardisation (ISO). The ISIN is composed of a 2-character prefix representing the country of issue, followed by the national security number (if one exists), and a check digit. Each country has a national numbering agency that assigns ISIN numbers for securities in that country.

AnyBIC.name: Any BIC
AnyBIC.definition: Unique and unambiguous way to identify an organisation.

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identification as an alternate identification for a place of safekeeping.
